comment: Source-guided burn_object expiry. A C-observed level-10 Barbarian wishes a tallow candle, selects it at inventory letter e, and lights it. The tallow age is initialized to 20 * oc_cost = 200 turns, so begin_burn schedules the first callback at age-75 (125 turns); if this wish resolves to the longer candle class, the frozen wait still reaches its first callback. `m.` provides the source-supported forced-rest while monsters are nearby. The capture must show the timer callback before it is included as a burn-object candidate.
